# CommunitySetupsManager

> **File:** `services/apps/CommunitySetupsManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The community setups gallery (github.com/axiom-shell/community-setups): downloads the catalog (CommunitySetups.indexUrl) when the gallery is opened, never before, and the setups' thumbnails and screenshots into the cache; applies one through SavedConfigsManager.applyShared (its look only, after a "before-<id>" backup), first installing its palette as the theme "community/<id>" and, when asked, its wallpaper; the result is saved as the snapshot "community-<id>", the active one. Every download goes through scripts/community_fetch.sh and is checked against the catalog's sha256. Nothing here runs in the greeter.

### Properties

- `enabled` (readonly bool)
- `setups` (readonly var): The catalog's setups (CommunityCatalog.parse), newest first; [] until the gallery is first opened
- `loaded` (readonly bool): The catalog was read (from the network or, offline, the cache)
- `loading` (readonly bool)
- `thumbs` (readonly var): { id: file URL } of the thumbnails downloaded so far
- `screenshots` (readonly var): { id: file URL } of the full screenshots downloaded (fetchScreenshot)
- `applying` (readonly string): The setup being downloaded and applied, "" for none
- `applied` (readonly string): The setup whose saved config ("community-<id>", saved by the apply, SavedConfigsManager.activeSource) is the active one, unchanged, "" for none: switching to another, changing the look or saving over…
- `status` (readonly string): What happened last, for the gallery

### Functions

- `open()`: Reads the cached catalog and refreshes it once per session: the gallery calls this when it's shown
- `refresh()`: Downloads the catalog again, then any thumbnails not cached yet
- `setup(id)`
- `search(text, tags)`: The setups matching `text` and every tag of `tags`
- `tags()`: Every tag the setups use, the most used first
- `missingFonts(setup)`: The setup's fonts that aren't installed (known once the gallery opened)
- `fetchScreenshot(id)`: Downloads a setup's full screenshot (into `screenshots`); asked for during another's download, it follows that one
- `apply(id, withWallpaper)`: Downloads a setup and applies it: its palette is installed first, its wallpaper (with `withWallpaper`) set once the config is
- `submitUrl(title)`: The issue form that submits a setup, its title filled in (attachments can't be)
